FlexibleInstanceGroupConfig.description: The configuration for High Obtainability (HO) flexible instance groups. Flexible instance group configs serve as the single source of truth for desired state.

bootDiskSizeGb.description: Optional. The boot disk size in GB. This is a create-time specification and is not currently mutable via update masks.

numInstances.description: Optional. The number of VM instances requested.For master instances, this must be 1. For worker and secondary worker instances, this represents the desired capacity of the group and is mutable via cluster update operations and autoscaling.

hardwareClass.description: Optional. The hardware class of the instances. This is a create-time specification and is not currently mutable via update masks.
enumDescriptions: Standard hardware class. Provides a balanced compute configuration with approximately 4GB of memory per vCPU and standard disk storage tiers.Candidate machine types include n4-standard, n4d-standard, n2-standard, and n2d-standard (Rank 0), and c4-standard and c4d-standard (Rank 1) (for requested core counts 2, 4, 8, 16, 32).Warning: The specific machine families and types selected for this hardware class are subject to change. Users should not take a dependency on the underlying machine type selection.

Performance hardware class. Provides a high-performance configuration with approximately 8GB of memory per vCPU (e.g. high-memory machine types) and higher-tier disk configurations (e.g. higher IOPS and throughput).Candidate machine types include n4-highmem, n4d-highmem, n2-highmem, and n2d-highmem (Rank 0), and c4-highmem and c4d-highmem (Rank 1) (for requested core counts 2, 4, 8, 16, 32). n4, n4d, c4, and c4d use Hyperdisk Balanced with provisioned storage, whereas n2 and n2d use SSD persistent disks.Warning: The specific machine families and types selected for this hardware class are subject to change. Users should not take a dependency on the underlying machine type selection.

coreCount.description: Optional. The number of vCPUs per instance. Must be a power of 2 (2, 4, 8, 16, 32). This is a create-time specification and is not currently mutable via update masks.
